ritual.lanterna.header: Ring rituals — how to be chosen:
ritual.lanterna.green.how: sleep through a whole night. Will sometimes calls the ring while you dream.
ritual.lanterna.red.how: kill many hostile mobs in a short time. Rage must overflow.
ritual.lanterna.yellow.how: face fear: stay under the Warden's Darkness, with it nearby, without running.
ritual.lanterna.blue.how: bring back hope: cure a zombie villager (Weakness + golden apple).
ritual.lanterna.violet.how: breed animals with your tamed pet by your side.
ritual.lanterna.indigo.how: show compassion: repair a nearly dead Iron Golem with iron back to full health.
ritual.lanterna.orange.how: carry a huge treasure while standing on a gold block. Only one per world.
ritual.lanterna.black.how: die under the Wither effect. The ring finds you when you respawn.
ritual.lanterna.white.how: cheat death with a Totem of Undying.
ritual.lanterna.yellow.hint: Yellow eyes watch you in the dark... don't run.
ritual.lanterna.orange.hint: The gold calls... but it is not enough yet.
ritual.lanterna.orange.taken: Avarice already has an owner in this world.
